subject: Platform check & recording-release checklist for 2027-03-02 webinar
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Events <ops@acmevents.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Platform check & recording-release checklist for 2027-03-02 webinar

Team — kickstarting the run-through for the BrightPath webinar on March 2. Acme is helping with ON24/Zoom encoding failover; we need to lock a few items this week so we can schedule dry runs. Please review and call out any gaps: 

- Registration form: fields we need (first, last, work email, company, job title, region, marketing opt-in checkbox, recording release checkbox with explicit text).
- SSO / SAML: BrightPath will use SSO for internal attendees — confirm test accounts.
- Recording release language: legal needs to sign off on the exact sentence we show on the form.
- Streaming failover: primary ON24, fallback Zoom via RTMP. Need encoder profile and RTMP keys.
- Sponsor assets: BrightPath logo variations (png/svg) + 30s pre-roll spot.
- Post-event on-demand: retention = 12 months, downloadable transcript?

Attachments: I asked Acme to send the preliminary config and a short screen capture from their last test. Acme, could you confirm streaming codec and test window availability?

Thanks,
Olga
Event Marketing (Field)
Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com

From: Acme Events <ops@acmevents.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Platform check & recording-release checklist for 2027-03-02 webinar

Hi Olga / team — attaching our config and a short capture from last week's test. Summary below: 

- ON24 primary: H.264 baseline, 1280x720 @ 3.5 Mbps; concurrent RTMP bridge to Zoom for fallback.
- RTMP keys: we'll provision temporary keys for the dry run, and a second set for the live event window.
- Registration form mapping: we can pass custom fields (job_title, region) into the ON24 payload; we will add an additional boolean field recording_release (true/false).
- Recording storage: ON24 stores recordings by session for 12 months by default; we can export MP4s and transcripts post-event.

Attachment: stream-test-invite.mp4 (video capture), on24-config.json (2.3KB)

Available windows for a platform dry run: Feb 24 10:00-11:30 PT or Feb 26 14:00-15:30 PT. Which works for you?

— Diego, Acme Ops
ops@acmevents.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Acme Events <ops@acmevents.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 10:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Platform check & recording-release checklist for 2027-03-02 webinar

Thanks Diego — that config looks good. A few follow-ups from our side: 

- Registration: please map recording_release -> metadata and make sure the checkbox label is the exact copy Laura will provide (legal wants the phrase verbatim).
- Sponsor pre-roll: BrightPath will upload a 30s ad; can you confirm we can serve it directly from ON24 before the live stream?
- Transcripts: we want automatic transcript generation and the SRT available for editing.

Laura — can you share the recording release copy by EOD? Tessa — I'll need you to confirm sponsor assets (logo + pre-roll) by Feb 22.

On dry run timing: Feb 24 10:00 PT works for me; hold it tentatively.

Marissa
Senior Events Manager 
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Events <ops@acmevents.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 11:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Platform check & recording-release checklist for 2027-03-02 webinar

Marissa / team — draft recording release text below. I marked a minor edit to make consent explicit for marketing reuse. Please confirm placement on the registration form (checkbox, not pre-checked):

"I consent to Redwood Inference and its partners using the event recording, my name, and profile information for marketing and educational purposes. I understand the recording may be made available on-demand and distributed to event sponsors."

If you're happy, this is good to go from legal. Attachment: recording_release_final.txt (plain text, 0.8KB)

— Laura
Legal Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Acme Events <ops@acmevents.com>, Erin Walsh <erin@brightpath.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Confirming dry run, roles, and assets — BrightPath webinar (Mar 2)

All — thanks for the quick turnaround. Summary / next steps: 

- Recording release: Laura's final copy will be used verbatim on the registration form (checkbox, required).
- Dry run: Feb 24, 2027 at 10:00 PT — please treat this as mandatory for Acme ops, our AV lead (Tessa), and BrightPath ops (Erin). I've sent a calendar invite (dryrun-invite.ics).
- Roles during dry run:
  - Acme: run platform failover test, verify RTMP keys, confirm on-the-fly transcript generation.
  - Tessa: verify sponsor pre-roll insertion and logo placement on the landing page.
  - Marissa: host flow and slide handoff timing, confirm Q&A moderation handoff.
  - Laura: brief 5-min check on recording release placement.

- Assets due: BrightPath logo variants (svg/png), 30s pre-roll video, and Erin's list of preferred landing copy — due Feb 22 COB.

Acme — please provision the RTMP test keys and share the test bridge by Feb 19 so we can do an encoder smoke test earlier in the week.

Thanks — Olga
Event Marketing (Field)
Redwood Inference
